q: You get a video call where a relative's face and voice urgently ask for money. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Report suspicious calls
Be alert to deepfakes
Verify by calling the relative on their known number
Share your UPI PIN
e: 'Share your UPI PIN' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Someone sends you a UPI 'collect request' saying you will receive money. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Approve requests from strangers
Remember you never need a PIN to receive money
Report the number
Decline the request
e: 'Approve requests from strangers' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Your computer shows a message demanding money to unlock your files (ransomware). What is the right thing to do?
o: Click more links in the message
Pay the ransom immediately
Share it with friends to open
Restore from a backup
e: Correct: Restore from a backup. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Someone shows signs of a stroke (face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty). Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Note the time and call an ambulance immediately
Keep the person comfortable
Make them walk around
Do not give food or drink
e: 'Make them walk around' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are using a fire extinguisher. What is the right thing to do?
o: Stand very close in the smoke
Pull the pin
Use a water extinguisher on an electrical fire
Aim at the top of the flames
e: Correct: Pull the pin. The other choices are unsafe.

q: An adult collapses, is unresponsive and not breathing normally. What is the right thing to do?
o: Wait for them to wake up
Start chest compressions in the centre of the chest
Shake them violently and leave
Give them water
e: Correct: Start chest compressions in the centre of the chest. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are using free public Wi-Fi at a café. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Turn off file sharing
Avoid online banking on it
Share passwords over it
Use websites with HTTPS
e: 'Share passwords over it' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.
